profile_text.body:
Teradata Corp /DE/ is a public company headquartered in San Diego, California, trading under the ticker TDC. On its own website the company describes itself as the AI platform for the autonomous era, connecting and scaling across any environment, and it markets an Autonomous Knowledge Platform that it says makes AI real, trusted, governed, and built to scale. The site also points to a product and service portfolio for AI, analytics, and cloud solutions, and states that the company partners with other providers to supply technology, AI-driven resources, and knowledge.

The site material does not name individual products, executives, or customers, and no products are tracked for the company in the record. Its stated position is that of a platform vendor selling governed AI and analytics across environments rather than a single application.

The company's record includes 270 cases in California. It is registered with the SEC under CIK 0000816761. No lawsuits, MCP servers, or product entries are listed for it.
